A cinematic 10-second extreme action martial arts video.

In a stormy ancient Chinese city at night, two elite swordsmen engage in a high-speed life-and-death duel across rooftops and narrow bridges.
One fighter wears flowing white robes with long silver-white hair, elegant and sharp.
The other fighter wears black battle clothing with red details, aggressive and relentless.
Both characters remain visually consistent throughout the entire video.

Action sequence:
The fight begins with both swordsmen sprinting at full speed across wet rooftops under heavy rain.
The black-clad fighter leaps forward first and unleashes a fast horizontal sword slash.
The white-robed fighter twists his body, narrowly dodges the strike, and instantly counters with a powerful turning slash.
Both swords clash violently with visible sparks and clear blade-to-blade contact.
The duel continues with rapid footwork, body rotation, aggressive pursuit, rooftop jumping, and intense close-range exchanges.
One fighter kicks off a roof edge, spins in midair, and descends with a powerful overhead strike.
The opponent blocks just in time, slides backward across the tiles, then immediately rushes forward again.
Rain splashes, fabric flies, long hair whips through the air, and the force of each attack feels physically believable.

Style:
high-end wuxia action film,
extreme motion,
cinematic martial arts choreography,
realistic sword control,
violent momentum,
dramatic rain atmosphere,
high-speed combat,
intense physical impact,
premium movie quality.

Camera:
fast tracking shot,
dynamic handheld movement,
low-angle pursuit shots,
wide rooftop action framing,
fast push-in during impact,
side-angle sword clash shots,
brief slow motion at the strongest hit moment,
cinematic motion blur.

Quality:
realistic anatomy,
stable characters,
clear sword trajectories,
clean weapon control,
consistent costumes,
strong body mechanics,
high motion coherence.

Negative:
extra limbs, deformed hands, broken anatomy, disappearing swords, bent blades, floating weapons, blurred faces, changing costumes, extra characters, text, logo, watermark.

She suddenly kicks off the motorcycle, launches into the air, lands on top of a car, and uses the momentum to leap forward.
She crashes into one enemy in a fast close-range hand-to-hand exchange, driving a powerful elbow strike into the opponent.
The opponent stumbles back.

workflow_bundle.default_output: Pre-CVR SaveVideo at approximately 1920x1088 / 24fps with Pass-1 audio reattached

pass2_shape_fix.fix: One shared scale controller drives the existing 3D upscaler and two ordinary size calculations. Pass 2 uses Ref2VA prompt/reference conditioning without re-encoding the first frame as a second exact keyframe.
pass2_shape_fix.prior_error: 2768x96 or 1760x96 conditioning rows could not fill the 2802x96 pass-2 layout

sampling.latent_upscale: MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D, shared scale=1.42, align=32; width/height derived by core ComfyMathExpression
sampling.pass1: TaoMate, euler/simple, exactly 3 steps, SelfLift transition_step 1, cfg 1.0
sampling.pass2: same TaoMate model chain, euler/simple, exactly 3 steps, denoise 0.35, DisableNoise
sampling.audio: Pass-1 audio latent bypass and reattach after Pass 2

rules: TaoMate 3-Step is the only acceleration LoRA and remains active in both sampling passes
Pass-2 scale is shared by the 3D latent upscaler and ordinary ComfyMathExpression width/height calculations
Pass-2 exact first-frame keyframe is disconnected; prompt and character references remain active
